page.overview:
Who is Riley?

Riley is a minor character that appears in the second season. She is an ally of cult-like worshipers of an ancient spirit known as Ka-Hor who sought to revive him.

Together with her friend Jane, the two unearthed the tomb of Ka-Hor. There, Riley and Jane found the deceased father of the latter who had also tried to revive Ka-Hor sometime ago and had been inadvertently trapped inside by Invincible. Riley and Jane then encountered Ka-Hor himself who exuded a menacing presence before revealing his desire to possess a male host in order to escape his tomb, as well as his prejudice and disinterest in females. They were all then inadvertently sealed inside the tomb by Invincible again.

During the Invincible War, a fight between the Immortal and an evil Invincible variant unearthed the tomb, allowing Riley to escape with a weakened Jane; the former only survived in peak condition thanks to her own abilities, and she quickly left to desert carrying Jane to get her aid, but not before berating Ka-Hor for his sexist views after he had failed to possess the variant.

Riley eventually returned to the tomb of Ka-Hor with Invincible. However, yet another inadvertent turn of events robbed Ka-Hor of his prospective host, which led him to reluctantly possess Riley instead despite his views, and he finally managed to escape his tomb.
